title: Zephyr C: time-provider trust machinery (spec 09 14.6) absent - simplified time_sync only
description: Spec 09 14.6 R-09-024..035, 036..061, 072..121: candidate sample provenance retention (immutable evidence issued at provider/verifier boundary, no caller-promoted booleans), provision verifier (44-octet Board-Identity||Record-Version||Epoch record, rollback binding version+epoch+digest, virgin-store marker minted once + atomically consumed, admin capability for replace/clear, sync non-reentrant hooks, distinct diagnostics), one monotonic-clock capability + opaque clock-domain binding for LinkLayer/provider/verifier/tracker, one-use receipts -> sealed immutable authenticated-DIO results, correction bounds (per-step, cumulative, 1e6 ppm cap, overflow-safe), replay barriers (one-use issuance consumed on first consideration, barrier before option compare, stable opaque generation keys), serialized tracker with live-floor re-evaluation on every read/transition. Classification: implemented+tested in Python ONLY (python/src/lichen/timing/provisioning.py, stratum.py, samples.py, source.py, time_sync.py; python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py, dio_handler.py, receipts.py; tests python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py ~2500 lines) - C/Zephyr lichen/subsys/lichen/link/time_sync.c implements only simplified subset (wall clock/floor/source classes/desync, no provenance evidence, no provision verifier, no receipts, no correction/replay policy); Rust lichen-link implements codecs/tables/floor only. Suggested placement: port provision verifier + tracker to lichen/subsys/lichen/link (persistent storage via NVS) or scope-documented decision that C nodes run reduced trust model; coordinate with human - large surface.
